description: End-to-end legislative intelligence pipeline for Brazilian Chamber of Deputies data using Medallion architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold → AI → API).

nodes.name: settings.py
nodes.summary: Loads shared configuration from config/settings.yaml into a frozen Settings dataclass. Supports environment variable override for CAMARA_API_BASE_URL. Used by all bronze extractors to get base URL, timeouts, page size, retry policy, and request delay.

nodes.name: logger.py
nodes.summary: Idempotent logger factory that writes to both stdout and a rolling logs/pipeline.log file. Respects LOG_LEVEL env var. All pipeline modules call get_logger() with a dotted name for hierarchical log output.

nodes.name: state.py
nodes.summary: Idempotency engine for bronze extractors. Persists a _state.json file tracking high-water marks (HWM), snapshot histories, and delta histories per endpoint. Atomic writes via tmp-file-then-rename. Provides load_state(), save_state(), record_snapshot(), and record_delta().

nodes.name: _http.py
nodes.summary: Shared HTTP client for all bronze extractors. Wraps httpx with exponential-backoff retry on 5xx, 429, timeouts, and network errors. Fast-fails on 4xx client errors (non-retryable). Exposes make_client() and get_json() helpers.

nodes.name: _pagination.py
nodes.summary: Generic paginator for the Chamber API list endpoints. Yields pages of records using pagina/itens query params. Detects the last page when records returned < page_size. Has a 1000-page safeguard to prevent infinite loops.

nodes.name: _writer.py
nodes.summary: Writes bronze JSON files to data/bronze/<endpoint>/<filename>.json. Creates output directories as needed. All bronze extractors route their output through this single writer.

nodes.name: deputies.py
nodes.summary: Bronze extractor for /deputados. Strategy: paginate the full list of ~513 deputy summaries, then fan-out to each deputy's URI for full profile detail. Merges summary+detail into {id, summary, detail} records. Saves one snapshot JSON per run named by today's date. Re-runs always overwrite today's file.

nodes.name: parties.py
nodes.summary: Bronze extractor for /partidos. Same snapshot+fan-out strategy as deputies but for ~21 political parties. Saves a dated snapshot JSON per run. Parties are treated as overwrite (no meaningful history) at the silver layer.

nodes.name: votings.py
nodes.summary: Bronze extractor for /votacoes using incremental delta with high-water mark (HWM). Uses dataHoraRegistro as HWM. On first run fetches 3 months of history; subsequent runs only pull records newer than the last HWM. No fan-out needed — list payload is complete. Always writes a delta file even when empty (audit trail).

nodes.name: propositions.py
nodes.summary: Bronze extractor for /proposicoes — the most complex extractor. HWM-based incremental delta on dataApresentacao, with 90-day date chunking (API limitation). Fan-out per proposition to fetch full detail. First run fetches 12 months. Supports --limit for smoke testing. Handles ~98k records on full backfill.

nodes.name: _db.py
nodes.summary: Shared silver loader that writes transformed DataFrames to Supabase PostgreSQL. Implements three SCD strategies: snapshot (expire all is_current rows, insert fresh batch), delta (expire only PKs in new batch), overwrite (TRUNCATE + INSERT). Adds loaded_at, source_file, and is_current metadata columns automatically.

nodes.name: deputies.py
nodes.summary: Silver transform for deputies. Flattens nested bronze {id, summary, detail} records using pd.json_normalize(). Selects ~40 columns and renames them to the silver schema contract (English/camelCase). Returns a typed DataFrame ready for Postgres via the shared _db.py loader.

nodes.name: parties.py
nodes.summary: Silver transform for parties. Flattens bronze party records and normalizes leader (liderança) sub-objects. Returns a DataFrame for overwrite-strategy load — parties table is always fully replaced, no SCD history.

nodes.name: votings.py
nodes.summary: Silver transform for votings. Reads bronze delta JSON, normalizes the flat list records, and parses the data field to extract a DATE column. Returns a DataFrame for delta-strategy load (only new PKs are expired).

nodes.name: propositions.py
nodes.summary: Silver transform for propositions. Flattens statusProposicao sub-object using json_normalize, selects ~32 columns, renames to silver contract. Parses dataApresentacao and statusDataHora to datetime. Returns a DataFrame for delta-strategy load. This is the target table for both AI enrichment jobs.

nodes.name: gold_deputies.sql
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL materialized view over silver_deputies WHERE is_current=true. Parses the redeSocial JSON array to extract twitter, facebook, and instagram handles as separate TEXT columns. Provides the clean, analytical deputies table for the API layer.

nodes.name: gold_parties.sql
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL materialized view over silver_parties. Since parties use overwrite strategy (no is_current), this view selects all current rows and flattens leader information. Joinable to gold_deputies via gold_parties.sigla = gold_deputies.partido.

nodes.name: gold_votings.sql
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL materialized view over silver_votings WHERE is_current=true. Exposes voting sessions with date, approval status (1/0), committee (siglaOrgao), and the free-text proposition description.

nodes.name: gold_propositions.sql
nodes.summary: PostgreSQL materialized view over silver_propositions WHERE is_current=true. Exposes all proposition fields including AI-enriched columns (tema_classificado, tema_score, resumo_executivo). This is the primary analytical table queried by the Text-to-SQL API.

nodes.name: embeddings.py
nodes.summary: AI Path A: topic classification via OpenAI text-embedding-3-small. Embeds each proposition's ementa and computes cosine similarity against 10 predefined Portuguese topic descriptions. Writes tema_classificado + tema_score back to silver_propositions. SCD2-aware: inherits classification from history rows when ementa is unchanged to avoid redundant API calls. Batches 100 rows per API call.

nodes.name: summarizer.py
nodes.summary: AI Path B: 3-line executive summary generation via gpt-4o-mini. Processes one proposition at a time, using ementaDetalhada when available. SCD2-aware: inherits summaries from history when ementa is unchanged. Commits after each row — safe to interrupt and resume. Portuguese system prompt focuses on practical impact.

nodes.name: auth.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI dependency for X-API-Key header authentication. Reads the expected key from the API_KEY environment variable. Returns 401 Unauthorized if the key is missing or wrong. Used as a dependency on all protected endpoints.

nodes.name: schema.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic v2 request/response models for the API. AskRequest carries the natural language question. AskResponse returns the original question, the generated SQL, the raw query result rows, and the LLM-formulated Portuguese answer.

nodes.name: sql_agent.py
nodes.summary: Text-to-SQL agent over Gold materialized views. 4-step flow: (1) LLM generates SQL from Gold schema context + user question, (2) regex safety check blocks all DDL/DML keywords, (3) executes pure SELECT against PostgreSQL, (4) LLM formulates a Portuguese natural-language answer from the result rows. Uses gpt-4o-mini for both generation and answer steps.

nodes.name: main.py
nodes.summary: FastAPI application entry point. Exposes POST /ask (authenticated) and GET /health. Validates required env vars (DATABASE_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY, API_KEY) on startup via lifespan context. Delegates question processing to sql_agent.run().

nodes.name: settings.yaml
nodes.summary: YAML configuration for all bronze extractors: Câmara API base URL, HTTP timeout, page size (100), max retries (3), backoff seconds (2), and polite request delay (0.2s between fan-out calls).

nodes.name: silver.yaml
nodes.summary: YAML configuration for the silver layer: per-endpoint table name, primary key column, source_type (snapshot/delta/overwrite), and bronze file path pattern. Controls which SCD strategy _db.py applies per endpoint.

nodes.name: run_deputies.py
nodes.summary: CLI runner for the deputies bronze extractor. Parses optional --limit argument for smoke-testing. Entry point: uv run scripts/run_deputies.py.

nodes.name: run_votings.py
nodes.summary: CLI runner for the votings bronze extractor. Invokes bronze.votings.extract() for incremental delta ingestion.

nodes.name: run_propositions.py
nodes.summary: CLI runner for the propositions bronze extractor. Supports --limit for smoke test (e.g. --limit 10) before full backfill of ~98k records.

nodes.name: run_silver_deputies.py
nodes.summary: CLI runner for silver deputies load. Reads unprocessed bronze snapshot files, calls silver.deputies.transform(), loads via _db.py with snapshot SCD2 strategy. Supports --dry-run to inspect the DataFrame without writing.

nodes.name: run_silver_propositions.py
nodes.summary: CLI runner for silver propositions load. Reads unprocessed bronze delta files from silver/_state.json, transforms, and loads with delta SCD2 strategy. Skips already-processed files automatically.

nodes.name: run_ai_embeddings.py
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for AI topic classification. Calls AI.embeddings.classify_propositions(). Resumable — processes only unclassified current rows.

nodes.name: run_ai_summarizer.py
nodes.summary: CLI entry point for AI executive summary generation. Calls AI.summarizer.summarize_propositions(). Resumable — processes only propositions with resumo_executivo IS NULL.

nodes.name: pyproject.toml
nodes.summary: Project manifest for the bussola-publica package. Declares Python >=3.11, uses hatchling build backend. Key dependencies: httpx, pandas, sqlalchemy, psycopg2-binary, openai, numpy, fastapi, uvicorn.
